subject: Hosted evaluation for NextParcel — deployment options and hosted quickstart
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.inference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@nextparcel.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted evaluation for NextParcel — deployment options and hosted quickstart

Hi Liam — thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we can map to the right deployment path.

Recap of your priorities:
- Launch a customer-facing summarization feature in Q4 with low latency (p95 < 400ms)
- Start with a small pilot (10k requests/day) and scale to ~200k/day after M1
- Data residency: US only for now; may require private VPC later for regulated partners
- Team prefers minimal ops work to get started — leaning toward Hosted if performance and rate limits fit

Deployment options (short):
1) Hosted API (fastest time-to-value) — sandbox access in 48–72 hours; supports streaming, function calling, and canary routing. We manage runtime, you get transparent rate bands and token-level cost reporting.
2) Dedicated (reserved capacity) — predictable throughput, isolated GPU pool, monthly commit; good for mid-term when you need burst guarantees.
3) Private (VPC / on-prem) — for regulated data and strict network controls; longer lead time (typically 6–10 weeks).

Immediate asks from us so we can recommend a concrete quickstart plan:
- Traffic profile: average qps, concurrency expectations, typical prompt & response lengths (tokens)
- Key SLOs: p95 latency target, allowed cold-start windows, uptime requirement
- Any immediate compliance docs (e.g., SOC2) you need before sandbox access

Attachments: hosted-onramp-playbook.pdf (playbook + example endpoint map), sample-ratebands.csv (example rate slices we can offer during trial)

Suggested next steps:
1) Share a short traffic sample (CSV) — if you reply with that I will assemble a hosted quickstart proposal and rate estimate.
2) I’ll request sandbox endpoints mapped to two production routes (chat vs batch inference) for testing.
3) Book a 30-min technical handoff with our infra engineer to confirm concurrency and prefix caching (link: https://cal.com/mina/30)

Cc'ing Marissa to flag potential need for a formal rate estimate and Priyom for sandbox provisioning.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: hosted-onramp-playbook.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB)]
[Attachment: sample-ratebands.csv (CSV, 18 KB)]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@nextparcel.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@nextparcel.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 15:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation for NextParcel — deployment options and hosted quickstart

Thanks — great demo. We are excited about Hosted as the fastest path, but have a couple of clarifying questions before we commit to a sandbox:

1) Rate limits & concurrency — what are typical hosted trial rate bands? Can you support sustained bursts to ~50 qps for short windows?
2) Pricing — can you share an estimated per-1k-token cost and an example invoice for a pilot?
3) Data handling — during Hosted evaluation, are logs retained outside the tenant? We need confirmation that PII is not persisted in customer-facing logs.

We also got a security questionnaire from our compliance team — attaching it. Priya (cc) will own technical validation on our side.

If Hosted can't meet burst/concurrency needs, we may evaluate Dedicated early. But prefer to try Hosted first if the sandbox supports your suggested canary routing and KV/prefix caching.

Cheers,
Liam O'Connor
VP Product — NextParcel
[Attachment: security-questionnaire.xlsx (XLSX, 240 KB)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.inference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@nextparcel.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 17:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation for NextParcel — deployment options and hosted quickstart

Thanks for the quick response and for attaching the questionnaire — our security team will take a look and we can schedule a call if they need clarifications. Quick answers below, and an example endpoint mapping attached to show how we split chat vs batch during an evaluation.

1) Hosted trial rate bands — example in sample-ratebands.csv. Typical trial bands we offer: 5 qps (free tier), 25 qps (standard trial), 75 qps (pilot) with short burst allowance up to ~120 qps for a few minutes. We can provision a dedicated trial slice up to 50 qps sustained for your pilot window; please confirm expected concurrency and burst cadence.

2) Pricing — per-1k-token guidance: gpt-style generative ~ $0.006–$0.010 per 1k tokens on trial tiers (exact depends on model choice/quantization). I’ll ask Marissa to provide a formal pilot estimate for 10k→200k/day traffic scenarios.

3) Data handling — for Hosted evaluation: request/response payloads are stored in encrypted logs for debugging by default but we can enable a no-persistence mode for your sandbox (no logs retained outside an ephemeral debug window). We also support token redaction and customer-managed KMS for keys in dedicated/private options.

Attachment: endpoint-mapping-example.json — example routes and canary percent.

Next steps I propose:
- If you confirm desired sustained qps and avg token lengths, Marissa will produce an estimate and I’ll spin up the sandbox endpoints (48–72 hrs).
- Security: our security team will respond to your questionnaire; if there are any items flagged we can do a short call next week with our security lead.

Quote: "We can get you sandbox endpoints and a hosted slice that mirrors your initial pilot traffic — the goal is to validate performance and cost before any commitment."

Best,
Mina
[Attachment: endpoint-mapping-example.json (JSON, 6 KB)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.inference.com>

Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: NextParcel hosted trial — ask list and timing (internal)

Internal note — copying action items so we have a single thread for ops:
- Marissa: please draft a pilot pricing estimate for NextParcel (deal HS-2345). Two scenarios: 10k/day -> 200k/day. Include per-model token rates and projected monthly cost. Use sample-ratebands.csv as a baseline.
- Priyom: provision a sandbox hosted slice (region: us-west) with endpoints: /v1/nextparcel/chat (streaming) and /v1/nextparcel/batch (non-streaming). Target: 50 qps sustained, allow 100 qps bursts. Enable no-persistence log mode by default.
- Legal: if they request any change to data retention, prepared a short MPA addendum (Marissa to loop Legal).
- Timeline: aim to have sandbox creds and the estimate live by Tue 2026-09-29 EOD so NextParcel can run preflight tests next week.

I’ll respond to Liam with confirmed timeline once you confirm provisioning ETA.

Mina
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
